name: jitera-connect
description: Connect this workspace to a Jitera project: read documentation and source, and keep project memory up to date.

jitera_api_key.title: API key
jitera_api_key.description: Create one in your project settings. Choose read + write access if you want the assistant to save memory and write specs.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Leave as studio for Jitera Cloud. Use studio-stage for staging, or studio-NN for a numbered pilot such as studio-04.
